name: aiterm-mcp
description: Drive Codex CLI's interactive TUI from Claude Code, plus durable tmux terminals for SSH, containers, REPLs, and coding agents.
long_description: Give an AI one persistent terminal for SSH, containers, REPLs, and interactive coding-agent TUIs. Claude Code can launch Codex CLI and drive its interactive features through the same MCP session. Reads are token-reduced, sessions survive client restarts, and humans can attach to the shared tmux session.

tools.name: pty_open
tools.description: Open one persistent tmux-backed terminal session.

tools.name: pty_send
tools.description: Send text to a persistent terminal or dispatch a turn to a managed agent.

tools.name: pty_read
tools.description: Read token-reduced terminal output or a managed agent transcript.

tools.name: pty_key
tools.description: Send a control or navigation key to a terminal session.

tools.name: pty_close
tools.description: Close one persistent terminal session idempotently.

tools.name: pty_list
tools.description: List the persistent terminal sessions owned by aiterm.

tools.name: claude_agent
tools.description: Launch an interactive Claude Code TUI in a managed persistent terminal.

tools.name: codex_agent
tools.description: Launch an interactive Codex CLI TUI in a managed persistent terminal.

tools.name: grok_agent
tools.description: Launch an interactive Grok TUI in a managed persistent terminal.

tools.name: composer_agent
tools.description: Launch an interactive Composer TUI in a managed persistent terminal.

tools.name: claude_turn
tools.description: Issue or recover a correlated managed Claude operation.

tools.name: claude_approval
tools.description: Inspect and answer a correlated managed Claude approval prompt.

tools.name: diagnostics
tools.description: Return a read-only, privacy-bounded factory readiness snapshot.
